evidenceKind: retained REA pseudocode plus focused original ARM64 disassembly and shipped SPIR-V

sharedPlacement.meshUV: Native UV is actual roof-trigger triangle UV. Barycentric lookup chooses first containing triangle with all3weights>=0; interpolate XYZ; wrapper adds [0,Roof+0x4c,0]. No matching triangle returns None. This is not AABB-normalized UV.
sharedPlacement.cache: Caches this world position and yaw; does not insert universal -.69 or+.27. Actual deck surface and native trigger coordinate spaces must be matched by caller.
sharedPlacement.axes: Assets local+Y up; trapdoor occupies XZplane; lamp stands+Y. No pitch90 or perpartrecenter.

trapdoor.orientation: ordinary window-kind roofattachment uses nearest rectangular roofedge yaw; circle radial yaw with centre fallback. Native trapdoor remains horizontal, not roof-slope-aligned.
trapdoor.holeMeaning: worlddelta rotated into normal-oriented localframe, divided by size; abs(x)<.5 && -.5<y<.5 &&abs(z)<.5. Full generalconsumer narrowsX by clamp(y*k+a,0,1)^3; k1,a-50 makes this trapdoor rectangular. Halfextents [.5625,.1875,.5625].
trapdoor.holeSource: Hardcoded separate DormerHoleSsbo::cottage record, not collisionAABB. No exactshapeSDF layerused for roof hatch.

rectangle.predicate: abs(localXZ) <= (roofRectangle.fullDims + paddingOnFullDims)/2 componentwise; rectangle own basis and centre are used

circle.predicate: Let d=distance(cachedXZ,roofCircle.centre), R=roofCircle.radius, r=testRadius. Native accepts when Circle2d.intersect_circle returns None: d>R+r OR d<abs(R-r). Tangency rejected. This is absence of circumference intersection, not a standalone containment predicate. Cached position already came from a roof triangle. For normal roof R>r and position inside it, acceptance reduces to d<R-r. Do not generalize this reduction to R<=r without upstream size constraints.
circle.record: Test circle has cachedXZ, radius .93 and copied roof yaw; method symbol Segment2d::new is a shared 4float constructor and must not be interpreted as a line segment here. intersect_circle reads the first2floats as centre and third as radius; fourth is unused.

nativeBoundaryAcceptance.scope: Fixed native asset scale. Applying arbitrary API scaling requires an explicit derived policy, not claiming an original scale-aware margin.

roofLantern.orientation: Flat roof lampkind6 uses userYaw+Roof.rotation_yaw_radians; bypassesedge-normalyaw.
roofLantern.emissiveShaderCenter: fullAffine(localLightPosition): includes model .8 scale -> origin+[0,.32000000953674324,0] for uprightbasecase
roofLantern.sceneLightPosition: WindowVisualEntityBuilder constructs worldXYZ=translation+rotate(localLightPosition), without modelscale; maintain_lantern_lights copies that worldXYZ to lightcache. Thus nativepointlight +.4 differs from nativeemissive shadercentre +.32.
roofLantern.preserveOrigin: Inside originalbounds centre is not lightplacement contract; do not recenter inside/outer independently.
roofLantern.stairsAttachment: Separate special branch can reposition rooflantern on stairs including -1.25Y; not partofnormalflatroofplacement.

limitations: Static chain proves code semantics, not observed runtimepixelalignment.
Roof+0x4c is proven addedY offset; exact domain field name not established inthispass.
User API arbitraryresizing extends nativefixedscale; decide explicitly whether scene point offset follows extra user scale.
Native triangleUV and parent surfaceUV need owning adapter, not directcoordinate equality.
Exact raw circle boundary acceptance is proven, but upstream minimum roof radius/size guarantee has not been established; preserve distinction from robust arbitrary-size API containment.

integration.roofUV: Host API normalized bounding rectangle maps to published flat-deck metric chart; not native triangle meshUV.
integration.deckY: Published flat building profile.maxY, matching existing flat deck topY-.69.
integration.cutting: Original full-size hatch hole drives host CPU material-cell subtraction and coarse deck polygon clipping; parapet charts excluded. Native replay is not required at runtime.
integration.sceneLight: Explicit lightPosition is published separately from model-scaled appearance.centers.
integration.clearance: Original .9299999475 roof-edge centre clearance, scaled with the public XZ size extension; actual full visual footprint is independently checked. Reject small circles rather than copying native circle non-intersection without a proven upstream minimum radius.
integration.orientationVerification: ConstructionRoofDecorations uses recoveredRoofAttachmentForward for hatch orientation; its deck polygon is derived from decoded f32 Hole48. FlatRoofDecorationProducer.spec.ts covers normalized rectangle-edge selection, circle fallback and rotated circular CPU polygon/native-volume containment equivalence. This is host integration verification, not a fresh Tiny Glade runtime capture.

attachmentOrientation.evidence: Original ARM64 disassembly and controlled binary-byte helper replay. No game-runtime image comparison.

rectangle.shapeInput: get_roof_shape_from_pos_ws_clamped(roof, cachedWorldPos + [0,1,0]).as_rectangle(). Use this returned cross-section, not an assumed unmodified base OBB.
rectangle.nativeRecord: 6 floats: [a,b,centreX,centreZ,fullWidth,fullDepth]. Basis localX=(a,b), localZ=(-b,a) in worldXZ.
rectangle.tieBreak: Normalized-magnitude tie always selects Z axis; selected component zero (including signed zero) selects negative edge. Centre chooses local -Z.
rectangle.notEuclideanNearest: The function name closest_edge_normal is misleading: it compares normalized centre coordinates, not physical distance to edge. 8x4 roof point(1,0) chooses +X although the Z edge is physically nearer.
rectangle.normalization: xz_rotation_bad normalizes the selected normal before building a quaternion.

circle.fallback: World +X, independent of circle yaw, not local +X. Equality to threshold goes radial.

orientation.forward: Source model local +Z points outward, in direction normalXZ. Local +Y remains world up. Native helper does not call atan2, but equivalent +Y yaw is atan2(normalX, normalZ).
orientation.typescript: const yaw = Math.atan2(normalX, normalZ); const q = [0, Math.sin(yaw/2), 0, Math.cos(yaw/2)];
orientation.quatCaveat: Equivalent quaternion may have opposite global sign from native and transcendental rounding differs. Compare transformed axes, not exact quaternion bytes.
orientation.trapdoorAdditionalYaw: Window-kind roof attachment starts identity; trapdoor does not add arbitrary user yaw in this cached path. The preceding userYaw+RoofYaw branch is for base kinds 6/7, not roof-window trapdoors. Flat-roof lamp kind6 bypasses the edge/radial step entirely.

limitations: Recipe covers valid positive dimensions and finite normalized roof basis; upstream invalid-shape invariants not re-audited.
For exact branch parity at threshold or diagonal, preserve native float32 operations; double precision may pick the opposite side at representational boundaries.
Helpers replayed in Unicorn; complete ECS cache producer not replayed.

flatHostOrientationAdaptation: Published horizontal deck footprint supplies the rectangle/circle cross-section. This does not claim to implement the native pitched-roof cross-section sampler. CPU deck boundary is derived from the same f32 Hole48 volume supplied to GPU clipping; unit placement and seed identity remain unchanged.
